config: Rev D (design): 8 identical lift points on the edge-truss joint-pair centres (x 928.5, 4456.5, 7543.5, 11071.5, both sides), each one vertical hanger strap pair (2 x 50 x 1.5 G450, both faces) from a saddle head over the roof edge truss down to a 120 mm cradle at the truss joint pair under it (two 3 mm cheeks, 2 x M16 bearing bolts under the joints; screwed at the first joint, bearing only at the second), so each lift point is settled by statics; saddle heads with no fasteners, keyed along the module by a stop block; floor edge trusses and the north roof edge truss in 1.15 mm; 4 screws per truss joint, gussets sized joint by joint, cleats 5 + 5 at every truss end, tie plates, floor and roof strap bracing and bridging; no temporary parts; pinned-beam cascade set to the measured CoG; design cases R1, R2, R4, 8 tilt cases at 2 deg and 4 sideways cases; skew, short-sling and slack-sling cases reported as information

rigging.note: largest drop force in the design cases x weight 1.03 x CoG 1.05 (no dynamic factor): drop gear WLL at least this. Interface: round sling eye down through the open top of the head box onto the free-turning 40 mm sleeve on the M20 pin, cheek tops fitted with edge protectors; shackles only at the beam ends. The rig (beams, slings, shackles) is lifting equipment: designed, certified to AS 4991, proof tested and rated; drops within 2 deg of vertical.
